name: megascenes-easter-coloring
description: Create printable Easter coloring pages with clean black outlines on white: bunnies, painted eggs, chicks, spring flowers and baskets, simple or detailed.

interface.longDescription:
Name an Easter subject and how detailed it should be: a bunny with a basket of eggs, an egg mandala, chicks in a spring meadow, a lamb among daisies, in simple bold shapes, medium detail or intricate patterns. You get a coloring page with clean black outlines on white.

ChatGPT tells you what the page needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The page opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to print.

For parents, teachers and anyone who loves to color, for a class activity, an Easter morning or a quiet afternoon.

Limitations: new pages from a description, without text on the page; it does not turn a photo into a coloring page. Designs are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Return the page in the chat
defaultPrompt: An Easter coloring page of a bunny with a basket of eggs, simple shapes
A detailed Easter egg mandala coloring page for adults
A coloring page of chicks in a spring meadow

positive.prompt: An Easter coloring page of a bunny with a basket of eggs, simple shapes. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one coloring page needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A detailed Easter egg mandala coloring page for adults. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one page needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make an Easter coloring page here?
positive.expected_behavior: The coloring page models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: An Easter coloring page of a lamb among daisies, medium detail. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my coloring page on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my coloring page to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
